title: Concept: Base64 basic-auth credential in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a base64 `user:password` credential written into the checked-in client configuration, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Base64 is encoding, not encryption: the pair decodes with one command, so the account can be used until the password is changed.
risk: Base64 is encoding, not encryption: the pair decodes with one command, so the account can be used until the password is changed.
